$comment: Traceability: cancellation/restart transaction rule and revocation row (data-model.md; control-core-unification.md §4). Replaces control.stop assignment and the control.cancelRequested reads in the PoC. Fire-and-forget from the service's perspective: the worker sets its local cancel flag (the PoC checkpoint() semantics are preserved locally), tears down containers, and appends a terminal event (run.cancelled) as termination evidence. A cancel carrying a stale generation is ignored by the worker.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

reason_detail.description: Operator-facing detail, at most 256 chars. Never provider internals.
